newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Tallinna Kaubamaja to open in Helsinki.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Tallinna Kaubamaja to open in Helsinki.

text.p: Leading Estonian retailer Tallinna Kaubamaja said on Tuesday it was planning to open a store in Finnish capital Helsinki in the second quarter of 1997, one of the first Estonian companies to expand into Finland.
The company also announced a nine month turnover of 390 million kroons and forecast a year profit of 28 million kroons and 1996 turnover of 550 to 600 million kroons.

Kaubamaja Chairman Toomas Luman said in a statement that the store was continuously developing, having so far invested 100 million kroons since privatisation. He said the Helsinki branch would be its first foreign venture.
The company's director general Peter Tohver said the investment in Helsinki would come to 30 million kroons.
"By expanding to Helsinki we have set ourselves the aim of getting a stable and growing Finnish customer base by offering a high-quality range," he said in the statement.
Tallinna Kaubamaja is one of the leading stocks on the over-the-counter market of the Tallinn stock exchange.
